title: Simultaneous EEG-SEEG recordings of deep mesial temporal sources (interictal spike epochs)
description: Simultaneous scalp EEG and stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings of interictal spike epochs from mesial temporal networks in seven patients with temporal lobe epilepsy (nine networks, 1945 spike epochs). Each epoch is 1 s long and centred on the peak of the earliest, highest-amplitude intracerebral interictal spike, band-pass filtered 1.5-30 Hz. The dataset supports investigation of how deep mesial temporal sources are reflected in scalp EEG.
methods_description: Recordings used a 128-channel system at 512 Hz with an analog 0.15 Hz high-pass filter and a scalp FPz reference. Earliest interictal intracerebral spikes were marked at the peak of the initial component (t0). Bipolar SEEG channels and scalp EEG were segmented into 1 s epochs around t0, band-pass filtered 1.5-30 Hz, with no artifact rejection.
